skill.summary: Autonomous RPC & VPN rotation for AI Agents. Ensures 99.9% uptime by bypassing geo-locks and rate limits on exchanges and Web3 protocols.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Proxy Guardian – reliable proxy/VPN rotation for AI Agents.

- Ensures 99.9% uptime by bypassing geo-locks and rate limits on exchanges and Web3 protocols.
- Automatically detects API timeouts and rotates through proxies and VPNs with smart node selection.
- Supports HTTP, WebSocket (OKX/Binance), and RPC (Solana/Base) protocols.
- Benchmarks latency to always pick the fastest route.
